title: Biocatalytic Tetrapeptide Macrocyclization by Cryptic Penicillin-binding Protein-type Thioesterases
authors: Paisley L. Jeannette; Zachary L. Budimir; Lucas O. Johnson; Elizabeth I. Parkinson
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PBP型硫酯酶催化四肽环化，虽用AlphaFold、分子对接和MD分析酶-底物互作，但对象为酶-肽底物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Cyclic tetrapeptides (CTPs) are a diverse class of natural products with a broad range of biological activities. However, they are challenging to synthesize due to the ring strain associated with their small ring size. While chemical methods have been developed to access CTPs, they generally require the presence of certain amino acids, limiting their substrate scopes. Herein, we report the first bioinformatics-guided discovery of a thioesterase from a cryptic biosynthetic gene cluster for peptide cyclization. Specifically, we hypothesized that predicted penicillin-binding type thioesterases (PBP-TEs) from cryptic nonribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS) gene clusters containing four adenylation domains would catalyze tetrapeptide cyclization. We found that one of the predicted PBP-TEs, WP516, efficiently cyclizes a wide variety of tetrapeptide substrates. To date, it is only the second stand-alone enzyme capable of cyclizing tetrapeptides, and its substrate scope greatly surpasses that of the only other reported tetrapeptide cyclase Ulm16. AlphaFold modeling, covalent docking, molecular dynamics, and mutational analyses were used to rationalize the broad substrate scope of WP516. Overall, the bioinformatics guided workflow outlined in this paper, and the discovery of WP516, represent promising tools for the biocatalytic production of head-to-tail CTPs, as well as a more general strategy for discovery of enzymes for peptide cyclization.
abstract_zh: 环状四肽（CTPs）是一类结构多样的天然产物，具有广泛的生物活性。然而，由于其小环尺寸带来的环张力，它们的合成颇具挑战性。尽管已有化学方法被开发用于获取CTPs，但这些方法通常需要特定氨基酸的存在，从而限制了其底物范围。在此，我们报告了首次基于生物信息学指导的硫酯酶发现，该酶来自一个隐秘的生物合成基因簇，用于肽环化。具体而言，我们假设，来自含有四个腺苷酰化结构域的隐秘非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPS）基因簇中的预测青霉素结合型硫酯酶（PBP-TEs）能够催化四肽环化。我们发现，其中一个预测的PBP-TE，即WP516，能高效环化多种四肽底物。迄今为止，它是第二个能够环化四肽的独立酶，且其底物范围远超唯一已报道的四肽环化酶Ulm16。我们利用AlphaFold建模、共价对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）和突变分析来阐明WP516广泛底物范围的原因。总体而言，本文概述的生物信息学指导工作流程以及WP516的发现，为头尾相连CTPs的生物催化生产提供了有前景的工具，也为发现肽环化酶提供了一种更通用的策略。
